title: Linear A numeric-literal type leak audit: ¹⁄₅ structural candidate and typed-token corrective replay

numeric_inventory_evidence.source_statement: The frozen corpus numeric inventory explicitly lists ¹⁄₅ as the value associated with a fractional/numeric sign and also lists additional fractional forms not covered by the legacy parser.
numeric_inventory_evidence.legacy_parser_problem: The historical FRACTION_MAP covered only a subset of these representations, allowing some numeric literals to enter the T/semantic candidate universe.

why_it_matters: A valid blind structural learner can rank an untyped numeric literal as a candidate word or suffix.
Even if the candidate later fails replication, its presence changes candidate counts, max-T familywise nulls, and structural geometry.
The correct repair must therefore happen before hashing and null generation, not only during post-score reveal.

typing_rules.NUMERIC_EXACT: Generic exact fractions/decimals are parsed as numeric slots/values.
typing_rules.NUMERIC_APPROX_OR_UNCERTAIN: Excluded from semantic identity but not assigned false exact magnitude.
typing_rules.SEMANTIC_CANDIDATE: Only this class may receive word/suffix identity hashes.

connection_candidate.name: TYPE_BOUNDARY_FAILURE_CAN_CREATE_HIGH_CONFIDENCE_NON_SEMANTIC_CANDIDATES
connection_candidate.statement: If numerals, punctuation, or other schema-level tokens share the same candidate identity space as semantic symbols, statistical discovery can produce highly ranked but ontologically invalid candidates even under strong null correction.
connection_candidate.falsification_requirement: Generalize only after analogous type-boundary failures are independently observed in another corpus or domain.

roadmap.step: Measure legacy-missed numeric token inventory directly on frozen corpus
Create canonical v2 research-state JSON using only the newest authoritative typed-token evidence chain
Only then start v0.7 formula-transition/neighborhood-role discovery
